name: Deposit in the largest tenth of Hyperliquid user vaults by equity, equity-weighted, rebalanced monthly (forward test only)
thesis: The one pre-committed variant that passed the study's test: of 56 track-record rules for picking Hyperliquid user vaults (closed vaults included, HLP excluded), the rule chosen on 2025-01..2025-10 (largest decile by equity among vaults >= $100k and >= 6 months old, equity-weighted) earned +44.4% a year over the savings rate actually paid out of sample 2025-11..2026-09, after the 10% profit share (Newey-West t 3.59, BH-adjusted p 0.005, block-bootstrap 95% interval of the monthly mean +1.8% to +6.0%). The study declines it: the rule was chosen as the least-bad of 56 variants that all lost in sample (it made -105% a year there, deflated Sharpe 0.055), it made -19% a month in the 7 months before the calendar and -77.7% a year over all 28 months of history (13 months positive), and in the test half its excess is explained by the size of BTC's monthly move (alpha after BTC and |BTC| -4.2% a year net, t -0.27; |BTC| loading t 2.52, R2 0.50). Track-record signals (3/6-month return, Sharpe, drawdown, flows, TVL growth) show no out-of-sample rank persistence among vaults large enough to deposit in.
mechanism: None demonstrated. Money concentrates in the vaults with the best recent record, so size selects whoever won recently: degen directional vaults in 2024-25 (Sifu, -99% lifetime index), systematic grid / mean-reversion / directional vaults in 2025-26 (Growi HF, Systemic Strategies, drkmttr). The 2025-26 set earned in large-move months in either direction (long volatility); the 2024-25 set lost in them.
legs: at 00:00 UTC on the 1st of each month: rank user vaults (relationship normal, not HLP) that are >= 6 months old and hold >= $100k by equity; take the top 10% (at least one)

deposit in each in proportion to its equity, capped at 10% of each vault's equity and at the room left before the leader's 5% floor (leaderFraction x equity / 0.05 - equity); deposits open (allowDeposits)
withdraw from vaults that drop out at the next monthly ranking (1-day lockup; the leader takes 10% of profit above the depositor's cost basis on withdrawal)
kill_criteria: forward test only: no capital until 12 forward months show net excess over the savings rate > +2% a year with t > 2 AND alpha after BTC and |BTC| > 0 with t > 2 (hl_vault_skill.py collect + analyze, monthly)
trailing 6-month net excess of the paper portfolio below zero: retire
room capped at 10% of each selected vault below $1M: no capacity
a selected vault loses more than 20% inside a month and closes: retire
the largest selected vault holds more than half the weight for 3 consecutive months: the rule has become one manager; retire
risks: single-manager tail: the rule's largest holding in 2024-25 (Sifu, about $10M) lost 99% of its time-weighted value; drkmttr, 41% of the test-half gain, moved -44% and +58% in single weeks
regime: the rule lost in the 17 calendar months before the test half and won in the 11 months of it; the test half's excess loads on BTC move size (long volatility), not on a manager edge
concentration: 3.3 vaults held on average, 12 distinct vaults across the test half
capacity: Growi HF, the steadiest test-half holding, sits at its leader's 5% floor (about $6k of room on 2026-10-10)

vault mechanics: withdrawals can force the vault to unwind positions; leaderFraction, follower counts and allowDeposits have no history in the API, so the deposit gate at past decisions is assumed open
data: returns are flow-adjusted from a 7- or 14-day grid (Modified Dietz); 1,100 core steps needed a conservative fallback (26 inside eligible holding windows)

evidence.notes: research/2026-10-10/hl_vault_skill/analysis.json: variants.choose_then_test, variants.table['size|q10|cw|u100k'], chosen (net_excess_savings, block_bootstrap_out, deflated_sharpe_out, late_entry_one_step, survivors_only), posthoc (regress_out_of_sample, contributions_out_of_sample, leave_out_out_of_sample, conservative_flow_timing, pre_calendar_months, full_history_chosen_rule), capacity_now.chosen; tables.md; scripts/hl_vault_skill.py (collect, analyze, render); precommit.json (sha256 af4ad904...)

quotes.note: declined; forward test only. Quoted at the test half's alpha after BTC and |BTC| (net, -4.2% a year, t -0.27); the raw test-half net excess over the savings rate was +44.4% a year (t 3.59) on 11 months, and the full 28-month history of the rule -77.7% a year. Room today, capped at 10% of each selected vault: $3.29M across 6 vaults ($46.4M of equity).
